parameters.amount: Positive amount in the group's currency as a plain number (5к = 5000, полторы тысячи = 1500, лям = 1000000). Taken from the message, never invented.
parameters.category: Exact category name from the user's active list, or a new generalized name when nothing fits. Plain text, never an emoji.
parameters.description: Short noun phrase (1-3 words) in the nominative case and the user's language; null when it would repeat the category.
parameters.suggestedCategoryIcon: One emoji, only when proposing a new category; otherwise null.
parameters.operationDate: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD only when the user named the day; null means today. A bare weekday is the most recent such day, never a future one.
parameters.repeatUnit: Only when the message has an explicit frequency word («каждый месяц», «ежемесячно», "weekly"); otherwise null.
parameters.repeatInterval: How many repeat units, 1 by default; null without repeatUnit.
parameters.repeatPhrase: The exact frequency words copied from the message («каждый месяц», «раз в неделю»); null when there are none. Never the item name.
parameters.paidBy: Who paid: a member name exactly as listed, or ME; null when the speaker paid. Only when members are listed.
parameters.splitWith: Who the expense is for: comma-separated member names, ME or ALL; null when not said. Only when members are listed.
parameters.operationType: EXPENSE for spending, INCOME for money received; null when the question is about both.
parameters.categories: Comma-separated category names copied exactly from the active list.
parameters.period: Preset period of the question; null when month or from/to is given.
parameters.from: Start of an explicit range, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
parameters.to: End of an explicit range, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
parameters.comparePeriod: Second preset period for COMPARE; null to compare with the previous period of the same length.
parameters.compareMonth: Second month for COMPARE as YYYY-MM.
parameters.member: Group member name as the user wrote it.
parameters.minAmount: Lower bound for the operation amount.
parameters.limit: Number of items for LARGEST or BREAKDOWN («топ-3» = 3).
parameters.direction: LENT when the user gave money, BORROWED when the user took money. For repayLoan it is the direction of the original loan.
parameters.person: The other person's name in the nominative case («Косте» = «Костя»).
parameters.dueDate: Return date as ISO YYYY-MM-DD only when it was said; otherwise null.
parameters.note: What the loan is for; otherwise null.
parameters.currency: ISO 4217 code only when the user named a currency other than the group's («5 долларов» = USD, «10 евро» = EUR, «100 лир» = TRY); the amount stays as said. Null otherwise.

addExpense.description: Record money the user SPENT or paid for something. One call per operation. Requires an amount stated in the message.

addIncome.description: Record money the user RECEIVED: salary, advance, bonus, freelance, cashback, a gift, a transfer to the user. One call per operation. Requires an amount stated in the message.

askFinance.description: Answer a question about the user's existing records. Use it for every question and for any spending or income phrase without an amount.

parameters.intent: SUM: one number (сколько, how much, когда, сколько раз). BREAKDOWN: list by category (на что, куда, какие траты, покажи траты). COMPARE: a named thing in two periods. TRENDS: which categories grew or shrank. LARGEST: biggest operations. PLACE: spending at a place. BUDGETS: budget status. BALANCE: what is left to spend this month. RECURRING: subscriptions and regular payments. MEMBERS: who spent how much. FORECAST: expected month-end total. AVERAGE: average per day or month. AFFORDABILITY: can the user afford an amount. SAVINGS: income minus expenses.
parameters.amount: The price to check for AFFORDABILITY.

addLoan.description: Record a NEW loan: money lent to or borrowed from a person. Check this before addExpense or addIncome.

parameters.amount: Positive loan amount taken from the message.

repayLoan.description: Money of an EXISTING loan came back: someone returned it to the user, or the user returned it.

parameters.amount: Returned amount; null means the whole loan.

outOfContext.description: The message is not about the user's money, or its intent is unclear. Never use it when the message has an amount next to a spending or income word.
